title: UKSSSC Constable Various Post Recruitment 2026
summary: Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) , has released a notification on its official website for the Recruitment of Uttarakhand Police Constable, PAC/IRB, Fireman, Forest Guard, Jail Warder & Other Various Posts. This recruitment is for 1694 positions. The UKSSSC application form will start on 25 November 2026, and candidates can apply until 25 December 2026. The minimum age required is 18 -21 years & the maximum age is 25 – 35 years as of 01 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the UKSSSC Constable & Other Post Recruitment 2026 provided below. ( Advt. No. 84/UKSSSC/2026 )

How To Fill UKSSSC Constable Various Post Online Form 2026

Interested candidates who wish to apply for the UKSSSC post can submit their application online before 25 December 2026 Use the click here link provided below under important link section to apply directly. Alternatively, visit the official website of UKSSSC to complete the application process online. Make sure to complete the application before the deadline 25 December 2026.
